answer: A raven that watches behavior, not badges: each agent earns a velvet reputation only after a long, independently attested work history — distinct task types, timing patterns, and peer interactions a farm cannot script in parallel. To forge one more identity, an attacker must replay that whole history from scratch: roughly 200 hours of genuine attested work plus a forfeitable stake per fake, so the tenth fake costs ten times the first and farming stops paying.
